info.title: DiceBear Universal API
info.description: Generate DiceBear 10.x avatars. Public API use is non-commercial; SVG is 50 rps and raster is 10 rps. Commercial or higher-volume use requires self-hosting or provider confirmation; styles have individual licenses.
